sections.text:
Juha had a beautiful voice, but he was very annoying. He would crow in the middle of the night and wake up the neighbors.

The neighbors complained repeatedly, so Juha decided to sell him in the market to get rid of their complaints.

Juha took the rooster and offered it for sale. A buyer came and asked him: “Does this rooster crow early in the morning and wake us up for prayer?”

Juha said: “This rooster, sir, is very smart and active! He does not wait for the morning, but rather crows in the middle of the night to save you the trouble of waking up early!”

The buyer laughed and left, and Juha returned with the rooster to his home after ruining his sale with his tongue due to his excessive frankness and strange intelligence.
